item.description: Am I wrong in thinking that videogames just DON'T have the same grip on internet culture as they used to? Back then there were all kinds of soulful forums and fansites dedicated to various game series and games like WoW, TF2, Minecraft or Gmod could become pillars of internet culture with people making memes, OC's and video content with them for years to come. Or hell, just look at how Undertale took the whole internet by storm for several years and even random vids would use Undertale
